budget.semantics: Reservations are upper bounds, actual failures count, unknown retains its full bound.

main.median_semantics: median of three paired B/A ratios, never ratio of group medians

target_only.median_semantics: median of three paired B/A ratios, never ratio of group medians

historical_state.old_cleanup: blocked by policy, original event retained, no alternate deletion
historical_state.static_CRLF_reconstruction_failure: retained as preparation failure, zero live attempts
historical_state.unexecuted_matrix_prepare: retained bytes, zero actual starts or rasters
historical_state.measurement_clarification: published before formal, enclosing call includes original finally receipt persistence

time_semantics.server: actual request received through stdout flush completion
time_semantics.client_transport: stdin flush through existing reader received_complete after raw response recording
time_semantics.complete_client_call: outer original call including its finally RECEIPT.json persistence
time_semantics.complete_session: startup, source checks, fixed calls, settlement and owned cleanup
time_semantics.postrun: saved validation after complete session, separately retained
time_semantics.nesting: intervals are nested, not added; the cache session occurs once across its three main request rows

setter_accounting.evidence_scope: actual fixed command responses, full terminal scene readback and pinned producer source; unrestricted Python is not a security sandbox

limitations: Twelve once-only finite engineering slots, with quality acceptance delegated to independent source and image checks.
Paired timing pass does not establish complete AI task benefit or broad asset coverage.
Stage/counter values that the source does not expose remain null. Source-derived possible loop visits are not actual measured visits.
Producer NPZ byte hashes and delivered PNG identity checked without new rasterization.
Separate Blender Win32 handle closure is unrecorded. Owned Popen exit and wait/reap are recorded. MCP retained runtime handle closure is recorded.
A worker close event's default unknown field is not process exit evidence.
Root owns the later archive receipt. This review does not create or validate an archive.
Experimental model/paid API use is zero. Coordinator/reviewer cost and unrepeated preparation cost are separate and not priced here.
